basic.name: Hamstring
basic.description: Deal 110~~0.04~~ damage and Slow enemies by 50%, decaying over 2 seconds. The Butcher's next Basic Attack will strike immediately.

basic.name: Butcher's Brand
basic.description:
Deal 37~~0.04~~ damage to an enemy and Brand them for 4 seconds. The Butcher's Basic Attacks against the Branded target heal him for 75% of the damage done.

Basic Attacks against Branded Heroes heal for double and extend the duration of the Brand by 0.5 seconds.

basic.name: Ruthless Onslaught
basic.description: Charge at an enemy, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed. If The Butcher reaches the target, they are stunned for 1 second and take 119~~0.04~~ damage.

heroic.name: Furnace Blast
heroic.description:
After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500~~0.04~~ damage to enemies.

Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

heroic.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
heroic.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171~~0.04~~ damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

trait.name: Fresh Meat
trait.description:
Upon dying, nearby enemy Minions drop 1 Fresh Meat and enemy Heroes drop 20 Fresh Meat. Fresh Meat can be picked up to gain 0.5 Attack Damage per Meat. The Butcher loses 15 Fresh Meat upon dying.

Quest: Collect 200 Fresh Meat.

Reward: Gain an additional 125 Attack Damage and 25% increased Attack Speed. Heroes continue to drop 10 Fresh Meat, Minions no longer drop Fresh Meat, and Fresh Meat is no longer lost on death.

activable.name: Enraged
activable.description:
While below 50% of his maximum Health, taking damage causes The Butcher to become Enraged for 10 seconds, gaining 40% Attack Speed and 25 Armor, reducing damage taken by 25%.

This effect has a 25 second cooldown.

activable.name: Bolt of the Storm
activable.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.

level1.name: Invigoration
level1.description: If Hamstring hits a Hero, half of the Mana cost is refunded and the cooldown is reduced by 1 second.

level1.name: Chop Meat
level1.description: Increases Hamstring damage by 100% to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level1.name: Block
level1.description:
Every 5 seconds, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Stores up to 2 charges.

level4.name: Flail Axe
level4.description: Increases the length of Hamstring by 40%.

level4.name: Cheap Shot
level4.description: Hamstring does 100% more damage to targets affected by a Slow, Root, or Stun.

level4.name: Unrelenting Pursuit
level4.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ruthless Onslaught by 33% upon impact.

level7.name: Insatiable Blade
level7.description: While facing a branded enemy, The Butcher's Movement Speed is increased by 25%.

level7.name: Meat Shield
level7.description: When Ruthless Onslaught impacts an enemy Hero, The Butcher gains 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

level7.name: Victuals
level7.description: Every time a nearby enemy minion dies, The Butcher heals 5% of his maximum health.

level10.name: Furnace Blast
level10.description:
After a 3 second delay, fire explodes around The Butcher dealing 500~~0.04~~ damage to enemies.

Can be cast while using Ruthless Onslaught.

level10.name: Lamb to the Slaughter
level10.description: Throw a hitching post that attaches to the nearest enemy Hero after a 1 second delay. This deals 171~~0.04~~ damage and causes the enemy to be chained to the post and Silenced for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Brutal Strike
level13.description: After using Hamstring, The Butcher's next 3 Basic Attacks within 5 seconds deal an additional 15% damage.

level13.name: Savage Charge
level13.description: Ruthless Onslaught deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 10% of their maximum Health.

level13.name: Cleaver
level13.description: Basic Attacks deal 35% of The Butcher's Basic Attack Damage in an area around the target.

level16.name: Crippling Slam
level16.description: Hamstring's Slow no longer decays, and its duration is increased by 30%.

level16.name: Enraged
level16.description:
While below 50% of his maximum Health, taking damage causes The Butcher to become Enraged for 10 seconds, gaining 40% Attack Speed and 25 Armor, reducing damage taken by 25%.

This effect has a 25 second cooldown.

level16.name: Blood Frenzy
level16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant 5% increased Attack and Movement Speed for 3 seconds, up to 25%.

level20.name: Fires of Hell
level20.description: Furnace Blast explodes a second time 3 seconds after the initial explosion.

level20.name: Slaughterhouse
level20.description: Lamb to the Slaughter now chains all enemy Heroes in range.

level20.name: Nexus Blades
level20.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

level20.name: Bolt of the Storm
level20.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.
